nom: TONYMOLY Wonder Ceramide Mochi Hydrogel Eye Patches

segments.dry: Reviewers with dry skin, including one with dry acne-prone skin, report strong hydration and relief from flaking under the eyes, with one crediting the patches for getting through winter dryness.
segments.sensitive: Reviewers who describe sensitive skin or sensitive under-eyes report no irritation, stinging, or burning, and one notes the fragrance-free formula as a plus for sensitive skin.
segments.mature: Reviewers in their 30s citing early fine lines, and one 38-year-old, report visibly plumped, smoother under-eyes and reduced fine lines after use, framing the patches as a pre-makeup or anti-aging step.

concerns.aging: Most reviewers report a visible reduction in fine lines, crow's feet, and a plumper, smoother look, some after a single use; a few state they see no long-lasting effect beyond the day of use.
concerns.dehydration: The large majority describe strong, immediate hydration and a soft, bouncy, plumped feel; a minority (including a 3-star and a 1-star review) say the patches dried up quickly or that the serum did not absorb and left a film.
concerns.redness: Only one reviewer specifically mentions redness, saying the collagen content helps with it; no other reviewer addresses redness directly.
concerns.barrier: One reviewer with thin, compromised eye-area skin reports the ceramides thickened her moisture barrier over time; no other reviewer discusses barrier repair specifically.
concerns.blemishes: One reviewer with acne-prone skin reports no negative effect on breakouts and strong hydration benefit; no other reviewer discusses blemishes.

Serum pills or leaves residue film

extraits.texte: I really wanted to like these and I had really high hopes especially after reading all the good reviews, but I was left very disappointed. First of all, they slip down your face the whole time and after taking them off, I noticed that the serum did not get absorbed by my skin and it just kind of left this film that started to pill of. Im not sure if the good reviews are fake or whats going on with them but these patches are horrible

For someone with dry acne prone skin this is the best eyepatches. My undereyes can get severely dry to the point of skin flaking off. But using the mochi patches have really helped me through this winter, the hydration lasts the entire day. Gonna continue to purchase these!

I have incredibly sensitive under eyes that are always dry, and I have never been able to find eye patches that don't sting or burn. I was hesitant to try these, but they worked like a miracle. My skin soaked up all the hydration from the patches and it totally revived them. I'm incredibly impressed, especially with the price point of these Eye patches. I will 100% be repurchasing these in the future! This was gifted by tonymoly.

I wanted to wait to use the entire container before writing a review to see if the negatives about it were true. It really depends on how much liquid is on the patches and how much liquid the patches are sitting in. I had ZERO issues with the patches staying on, drying correctly, and no little goo balls after drying until about halfway into the package. The little goo balls that flake off only happened in the last 4 applications because there was so much liquid still in the packaging compared to the ratio at the beginning. As far as efficacy, they do what they are for (which is not hydration, you need hyaluronic acid for that). I have genetic related bags under my eyes and was looking to give my bags a serious punch of ceramides because my other eye products lacked it. The niacinamide was a big bonus - the best way to describe what it's done is making my skin cells look small, smooth, and "normal" (sorry I didn't take pictures). I can tell a difference immediately, so much so that I can see where the edge of the patch was because my skin looks so much better on the skin that received the patch. Earlier in the package dried out faster than later in the package. The only reason I'm not re-buying this is because I got a new eye cream that does have ceramides and I've gotten the benefits I bought it for (thickening the moisture barrier of my thin eye skin). Highly recommend if you need a ceramide boost for your eyes. Even if they are moving all around by the end of the package, i

I recently was offered by TONYMOLY their Plump Under Eyes Powered by Collagen and Ceramides, and I'm impressed! The packaging is convenient, with each patch individually packed for easy use. The patches are generously sized and adhere well to the skin. The formula is hydrating and soothing, thanks to the collagen and ceramides. After just one use, my under-eye area felt plumper and refreshed. I appreciate that they are fragrance-free, which is great for sensitive skin. After using them for a few weeks, I've noticed an improvement in the overall appearance of my under-eye area. They have become a staple in my skincare routine, and I highly recommend them for anyone looking to hydrate and rejuvenate their under-eye area.

first time trying this patches and I really enjoyed them, the serum that comes with them is really hydrating and nourishing, im on my early 30s so my underage area is starting to show some fine lines and a really good skincare routine and prep before makeup is very important to not make them more noticeable, so this patches are perfect for that, I place them before makeup to get a beautiful under eye, I recommend them, gifted by tonymoly

extraits.titre: Doesn't live up to the reviews
extraits.texte: I wanted to love these eye patches but after about two minutes they tend to dry up and not moisturize like advertised. They also didnt do much for my under eyes, where ive had way cheaper ones refuce puffiness these did not. Not worth the price for these, ive gotten better for way less.
